# PNGTuberMaker

> AI-powered PNGTuber avatar generator for streamers

PNGTuberMaker helps Twitch, YouTube, and Discord streamers create professional PNG avatars using AI. Generate custom characters and expression packs in minutes — no artistic skills required.

## Features

- AI avatar generation from text or image prompts
- Expression packs (happy, angry, sad, surprised, and more)
- Animation generation (blinking, mouth movement)
- HD/4K upscale and variations
- Commercial license available (Pro tier)

## Pricing

- Free: 3 generations/month, 512px export
- Start ($9/mo): 50 generations/month, HD 1080p export, basic expressions
- Pro ($30/mo): Unlimited generations, 4K export, all expressions & animations, commercial license
